summary: @servicetitan/admin-layout 2.4.7 preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB payload
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs setup.mjs, an obfuscator.io-style script (hex _0xNNNN identifiers, string-lookup indirection). setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases into a temporary directory and then execFileSyncs Bun against math_init.js, a 727KB heavily-obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle shipped at the package root (string-array rotate deobfuscator, mixed numeric/string dictionary). math_init.js is not referenced by dist/ (the advertised React admin-layout entry point) and its function is unrelated to the package's stated purpose. The alternate-runtime invocation pattern executes an opaque payload on the installer's host at npm install time, evading Node-focused scanners. Ships under the @servicetitan npm scope, consistent with a scope-impersonation or scope-compromise supply-chain attack pattern.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
